name: Total Healthcare Solutions
old_description: It has been our goal to provide the highest quality of home healthcare equipment, supplies and services, in a cost-effective manner, to all our patients. We strive to improve the health of our patients in a manner that distinguishes us in our industry. Patient rights, responsibilities, dignity and confidentiality are our highest priority in the delivery and follow-up process.
about:
Total Healthcare Solutions operates from Ridgeland, Mississippi, as a locally and privately owned durable medical equipment (DME) company. The firm does not disclose its founding year or founders, but presents itself as an accredited supplier focused on one-to-one relationships with patients and providers.

The company supplies home healthcare equipment and supplies while providing a suite of support services. These include a dedicated billing specialist handling Medicare, Medicaid, and private insurance claims; assistance reworking denied claims; product and equipment education and fitting; direct patient communication; and coordination with claim adjusters and case managers. THS reports 27-plus insurance partnerships, 63-plus medical manufacturer relationships, 596-plus physician partnerships, and more than 8,500 clients served.

THS serves patients requiring home medical equipment, referring physicians, insurance payers, and medical manufacturers. Testimonials describe patients receiving catheters and other supplies with follow-up calls to confirm delivery, illustrating the company's role in the last-mile fulfillment and patient-support chain for DME.

The company states its mission is to deliver the highest quality equipment, supplies, and services cost-effectively while prioritizing patient rights, dignity, and confidentiality. Its stated strategy emphasizes fantastic communication, accurate and honest billing, and long-term relationships as the foundation of its approach.
